name: light-leak
title: Light Leak
description: A warm analog light leak drifts across the frame, blows out at the cut and cools off on the next scene.
useWhen: The video has a film, lifestyle or nostalgic look and the cut should feel like light hitting the negative.
A warm, soft cut between two scenes that would otherwise hard-cut, such as a montage of shots.
The palette should match a brand: the leak takes any colours.
avoidWhen: The video is a crisp UI or data piece where a warm burn looks out of place: use fade-through.
The cut should feel like a camera move rather than light: use whip-pan.
Both scenes are very bright: the blow-out loses contrast.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Origin
variables.description: Edge the leak drifts in from.

variables.label: Intensity
variables.description: Strength of the leak and the blow-out, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Blow-out color
variables.description: Tint the frame blows out to at the cut.
